affected_profile: v5 source-scoped approved terms; no natural-source ledger approved
expected_invariant: A scoped reviewed source term missing every approved Russian form in its matching output line produces an advisory without rewriting accepted text or inferring language quality.

related_controls.condition: The same approved source name is omitted in an ending block.
An approved inflected Russian form satisfies the term in a middle block.

negative_controls.condition: A different Chinese venue name in the next source line does not inherit the approved term.
A name appearing only in source context does not authorize a target warning.
An uppercase Russian form still satisfies the reviewed spelling.
